name: River
description: Alternating text-and-media rows ('riverflow'). Renders a single block with the image left or right (or with a video play overlay), or stacks multiple blocks that alternate sides automatically. Media aspect ratio is set section-wide with per-block overrides.
when_to_use: Storytelling sequences — services, process steps, or project chapters where each row pairs a paragraph with an image. Use Section for one richer block with gallery/background; use Features for compact card grids.
capabilities: single row or stacked riverflow with automatic left/right alternation
video treatment with play overlay (video variant)
per-block CTA button plus a small footnote line
aspect-ratio presets incl. golden ratio, overridable per block
title <strong> emphasis in the accent color

variants.description: Single block, text left / image right. Default.
Single block, image left / text right.
Single block whose media renders with a play overlay.
Renders all blocks[], alternating media side per row.

breakpoints.mobile: Each row stacks text above media.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column rows, media side alternating in the stacked variant.

ai.prompt_summary: River: alternating text+media rows. Settings: variant (image-right|image-left|video|stacked), aspect_ratio (1/1|16/9|3/2|4/5|21/9|golden, default 3/2). Rows in blocks[] (min 1; single-block variants use the first): { eyebrow, title (supports <strong> accent), subline, body, button_label, button_to, note (footnote below the button), aspect_ratio (empty = inherit), image, image_alt }.
ai.content_guidelines: 2-4 blocks for the stacked variant. Bodies 2-4 sentences; one <strong> emphasis per title. Footnotes short (availability, disclaimers).

field_hints.blocks: Single-block variants read only the first entry; stacked renders all, alternating sides.
field_hints.blocks.aspect_ratio: Leave empty to inherit the section-level ratio.
field_hints.blocks.note: Small line rendered below the button.
